## Turning everyday incidents into proactive crime prevention

Unlike traditional case management tools, simplify incident reporting and enable secure collaboration between stores, retailers, and law enforcement, turning incidents into patterns, and patterns into outcomes.

Instead of reacting to crime, you get ahead of it, stopping repeat offenders and organized groups before they strike.

[Discover the Auror Network](https://www.auror.co/network)

our technology

## All connected in one intuitive platform

Your central hub for Retail Crime Intelligence.

Our platform sits at the heart of our network. It’s where retailers capture events without friction, connect the dots between stores and cases, and identify potential threats.

‍

Armed with this intelligence, retailers and law enforcement agencies can act quickly and decisively, solving cases together, faster than ever.

[Discover the Auror Network](https://www.auror.co/product/overview)

See the platform

Privacy and Security

## Designed to keep you in control of your data

Secure, private, and transparent. We take data protection seriously.

Every part of our platform was created to enable safe and effective collaboration, protecting sensitive information while giving users complete ownership of their data.

**Privacy-first design**

Our platform was built using privacy-by-design principles, ensuring only relevant information is entered and letting you control how that information is used.

**Granular control**

**‍** **‍** Auror gives you full control over what you share and who can see it, from stores within your organization to other retailers and law enforcement agencies.‍

**Enterprise-grade encryption**

We use 256-bit SSL encryption to ensure your data is fully protected at all times. Secure end-to-end.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Auror?

Auror is the [Retail Crime Intelligence](https://www.auror.co/retail-crime-intelligence) platform that turns insolated incidents into positive outcomes, connecting 85,000 stores and 3,500+ law enforcement agencies to reveal the patterns that matter most to stop retail crime. By making it easy to capture high-quality incidents, responsibly connect repeat offenders and organized groups to identify the highest harm offenders, and securely collaborate with retail peers and law enforcement, Auror gives retailers and law enforcement the intelligence to act, not just report, outperforming traditional case management solutions. The Auror Network surfaces known offenders, activates police coordination, and delivers measurable outcomes fast. Built with privacy by design, retailers stay in full control of their data. The result: fewer repeat offenses, safer stores, and stronger communities.

### What is Retail Crime Intelligence?

[Retail Crime Intelligence](https://www.auror.co/retail-crime-intelligence) is the category Auror defined and leads today. Unlike traditional loss prevention and case management tools that only log incidents at the individual store level, Retail Crime Intelligence treats crime as a connected problem requiring a coordinated solution. It turns reported events into sharable event data that compounds insights across stores, retailers, and jurisdictions. It surfaces repeat offenders, organized retail crime networks, and emerging risk that no single store could see alone. Event data is controlled by the retailer that collects it, who determines what to share and when. Intelligence flows across the Auror Network connecting retailers and law enforcement, so everyone acts on the same picture. The measure of success is not the number of reports filed, but outcomes delivered: prolific offenders held accountable, shrink reduced, and stores made safer.

### How does Auror make stores safer?

Auror surfaces the small proportion of prolific offenders driving the majority of loss and harm. By connecting incidents across stores and retailers, detecting known threats in real-time through vehicle and subject recognition, and giving law enforcement actionable intelligence, Auror helps retailers move from reactive incident reporting to coordinated prevention to reduce shrink, violence, and repeat offending.

### Where does Auror operate?

Auror operates across North America (including the United States, Canada, Mexico, and other parts of Latin America), the United Kingdom, Republic of Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand, connecting over 85,000 retail locations with more than 3,500 law enforcement agencies globally. The platform is the largest, fastest-growing network of its kind in the world.

## Frequently asked questions

### Are there any costs?

![Down arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/60b6db58588f2a3e2270ccde/60b6db58588f2a80ee70ce8f_Arrow-down.svg)

Our community program allows us to provide Auror free for all ORCA members.

### How secure is this given you’re storing sensitive information?

![Down arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/60b6db58588f2a3e2270ccde/60b6db58588f2a80ee70ce8f_Arrow-down.svg)

We’re also partnered with Microsoft globally to utilize their world-class data centers, technology, and security best practices. Find out more in our [Trust Center](https://www.auror.co/trust-center).

### What’s the effort required to get this set up?

![Down arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/60b6db58588f2a3e2270ccde/60b6db58588f2a80ee70ce8f_Arrow-down.svg)

![Down arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/60b6db58588f2a3e2270ccde/60b6db58588f2a80ee70ce8f_Arrow-down.svg)

No. We encourage all of your members to join and share intelligence. The more the better.

### Do we get a website provided to communicate important information to our ORCA members?

![Down arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/60b6db58588f2a3e2270ccde/60b6db58588f2a80ee70ce8f_Arrow-down.svg)

Yes. We’ll set you up with a website template that you can own, refine, and update moving forward.
